_comment: Synthetic. Completion history — the raw material for per-area capacity actuals. This is PAGE ONE of two, and it is deliberately SHORTER THAN THE PAGE SIZE while still carrying a `next_cursor`: a reader that stopped at 'fewer items than I asked for' would silently truncate the history here, and completion history is what capacity actuals are built from. Note the third entry, which has no recorded duration at all — the common case, and the reason CAPACITY_DEFAULT_TASK_MINUTES exists. The item shape is the v1 endpoint's, which returns the task itself: the id arrives as `id`, not v9's `task_id`.
